set.notes: Sub-solidus triangles name the compounds (silica; sodium-aluminosilicate = NAS2, nepheline below the boundary), not their modifications. Nepheline (and NaAlO2) form solid solutions drawn as dotted bands. The nepheline–corundum–β-alumina (Na2O·11Al2O3) triangle is drawn dashed (line from the nepheline band to the Na2O·11Al2O3 circle, inset ≈ (1057, 1017)). Triangles with Na2O·Al2O3 and Na2O are drawn dashed and are outside the phase catalog.

set.region: Na2O·Al2O3 field (Na2O-Al2O3 side, left of the carnegieite/β-alumina boundary)
set.notes: No field label and no boundary between the carnegieite and Na2O·Al2O3 fields drawn; the carnegieite/β-alumina boundary reaches the Na2O-Al2O3 edge at (2314, 2042), between the Na2O·Al2O3 (2171) and Na2O·11Al2O3 (2736) circles. No temperatures on the Na2O-Al2O3 edge. Corner labels: Na2O ~920, Al2O3 ~2020.
